items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: But I played with some of the newer avante garde, new age rocker kind of guys like Bryan Ferry.

ctx.x: I have no idea. I just didn’t go to Berlin with them. You know I didn’t play with them anymore. But I played with some of the newer avante garde, new age rocker kind of guys like Bryan Ferry. And I was holding down a six night a week gig in Nottingham of all places. I would have to drive from London and stay over a couple of nights and play and have just a big dance band. But we would just do all kinds of stuff.
